title: Canonical Seed Man Character Master

sourceReference.lockedIdentity: green armored plant hero with a compact readable platformer silhouette, large expressive eyes, leafy head crest, green-and-white suit/armor treatment, gloves and boots, and stable proportions across views and future animation
sourceReference.notes: The authoritative runtime manifest and approved 2026-09-08 showcase control this batch. Do not regress to the earlier brown oval seed-body mascot, cape variants, human/anime variants, or unrelated costumes. Do not redesign the character while producing reference views.

runtime.integrationAfterApproval: Derive normalized animation masters/atlases; do not replace the current approved runtime atlas from this reference batch alone.

output.background: transparent or neutral production-sheet background as appropriate
output.colorRule: No yellow cast; preserve the approved green/white visual identity and strong readable outline.

reviewArtifacts.reason: Concept introduced cape/armor and a different brown seed-body identity rather than the authoritative green-armored-plant-hero. Retained only as review evidence.
Concept drifted into an anime/human hero with leaf hair and clothing. It does not match the approved runtime character silhouette and must not integrate.
Closer to a mascot construction, but still regressed to the earlier brown seed-body concept instead of the approved green-armored-plant-hero. Keep only for comparison.
Produced a brown seed-body/cape mascot again and mixed noncanonical world/item concepts. It is explicitly rejected from runtime use.

assets.name: Neutral face and facial construction close-up

acceptanceCriteria: all ten assets clearly depict the same authoritative green-armored-plant-hero identity
front/three-quarter/side/back views agree on body, leaf crest, glove and boot proportions
no regression to the older brown oval seed-body mascot, human/anime hero, cape, or unrelated costume
silhouette remains readable at platformer game scale
clean edges suitable for later sprite normalization
future bottom-center animation anchor is unambiguous
source files are placed in the SM-001 Drive source folder before approval
approved versions are promoted to Drive Approved Masters before animation batches begin
